#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const int maxn=5007;
const ll INF=1e9;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    ll cap, cost, flow;
    Edge(int f, int t, ll c, ll co): from(f), to(t), cap(c), cost(co), flow(0) {}
};

vector<Edge> edges;
ll dist[maxn], potential[maxn];
vector<int> graph[maxn];
int parent[maxn];

void addEdge(int u, int v, ll cap, ll cost) {
    graph[u].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(u, v, cap, cost);
    graph[v].push_back((int)edges.size());
    edges.emplace_back(v, u, 0, -cost);
}

void bellmanFord(int s, int n) {
    for (int i=0; i<maxn; i++) potential[i]=INF;
    potential[s]=0;
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (auto &e: edges) {
            if (e.cap==e.flow) continue;
            int u=e.from, v=e.to;
            ll c=e.cost;
            if (potential[u]==INF) continue;
            potential[v]=min(potential[v], potential[u]+c);
        }
    }
}

void dijkstra(int s) {
    for (int i=0; i<maxn; i++) dist[i]=INF;
    dist[s]=0;
    set<pair<ll,int>> pq;
    pq.insert({0,s});
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        int v=pq.begin()->second;
        pq.erase(pq.begin());
        for (int eid: graph[v]) {
            auto &e=edges[eid];
            if (e.cap==e.flow) continue;
            int to=e.to;
            ll cost=e.cost+potential[v]-potential[to];
            if (dist[v]+cost<dist[to]) {
                pq.erase({dist[to], to});
                dist[to]=dist[v]+cost;
                parent[to]=eid;
                pq.insert({dist[to], to});
            }
        }
    }
}

pair<ll,ll> minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
    bellmanFord(s, 50);
    dijkstra(s);
    ll totalFlow=0, totalCost=0;
    while (true) {
        if (dist[t]==INF) break;
        ll flowPushed=INF, sumCost=0;
        for (int tmp=t; tmp!=s; tmp=edges[parent[tmp]].from) {
            int eid=parent[tmp];
            flowPushed=min(flowPushed, edges[eid].cap - edges[eid].flow);
            sumCost+=edges[eid].cost;
        }
        totalFlow+=flowPushed;
        totalCost+=flowPushed*sumCost;
        for (int tmp=t; tmp!=s; tmp=edges[parent[tmp]].from) {
            int eid=parent[tmp];
            edges[eid].flow+=flowPushed;
            edges[eid^1].flow-=flowPushed;
        }
        dijkstra(s);
        for (int i=0; i<maxn; i++) potential[i]=dist[i];
    }
    return {totalCost, totalFlow};
}

void solve() {
    int n,m,k,c,d;
    cin>>n>>m>>k>>c>>d;
    vector<int> count(n,0);
    for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        int ai;
        cin>>ai;
        ai--;
        count[ai]++;
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        addEdge(5000, i, count[i], 0);
    }
    for (int it=0; it<m; it++) {
        int u,v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int i=0; i<99; i++) {
            ll costVal=d + 2*d*i;
            addEdge(u+i*50, v+(i+1)*50, 1, costVal);
            addEdge(v+i*50, u+(i+1)*50, 1, costVal);
        }
    }
    for (int i=0; i<=99; i++) {
        addEdge(0+i*50, 5001, INF, c*i);
    }
    for (int i=0; i<n; i++) {
        for (int j=0; j<99; j++) {
            addEdge(i+j*50, i+(j+1)*50, INF, 0);
        }
    }
    auto p=minCostMaxFlow(5000, 5001);
    assert(p.second==k);
    cout<<p.first;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout<<fixed<<setprecision(20);
